ModMetaData.name: WorkRoles
ModMetaData.author: Morten Mertner
ModMetaData.description:
WorkRoles allows you to set work priorities by assigning named roles to colonists, instead of fiddling with priority numbers.
Key Features: - Easy Setup: Seeds ready-made roles (Doctor, Smith, Hauler, ...) covering every vanilla and DLC work type, then auto-assigns them to match your existing priorities. - Quickly Reprioritize: Toggle any role globally or per colonist without touching the underlying assignments. - Powerful UI: Easy to use, with options to group, sort and filter views. Key bindings for navigation, drag to assign roles. - Smart Recommendations: A per-colonist panel suggests roles from passions, genes, colony-best skills, training opportunities and colony needs. Apply per colonist or fix the whole colony with a preview. - Modded Jobs: Work types and jobs from other mods appear automatically, no compatibility patches needed. - Multiplayer Support: Fully RimWorld Multiplayer compatible. - Save Compatible: Safe to add (priorities convert to roles) and safe to remove (the vanilla Work tab comes back sensibly populated).
This is far from a comprehensive list of features. Check the project README or Steam workshop page for additional details.
Requires Harmony. Not compatible with other Work tab replacements or priority-setting mods.
Check out my other mods: EPrime's Readouts and EPrime's Quality Jobs.
